store.summary: TNT AV Net Tools: find AV gear, Dante/NDI, PTP, terminal and checks
store.description: Part of TNT (Tech Nomad Ted) tools, TheTechNomad.com. Network tools for AV installs: network basics, ping, traceroute, IP scan with MAC makers and names, Dante, NDI, AES67/SAP and mDNS discovery, PTP leader and Dante health (leader changes, sync dropouts, multicast flooding, IGMP querier), Find AV gear (Crestron, Extron, Q-SYS, Biamp, Shure, Netgear AV Line) with control-port checks and info pulls after login, a Hercules-style SSH/Telnet/TCP/UDP/serial terminal with saved commands, a control-protocol sniffer (Crestron CIP, Q-SYS QRC, Extron SIS, PJLink), pcap capture from a mirror port, DHCP rogue, IP conflict, LLDP/CDP and cable checks, and saved per-site reports. Shows on the built-in screen and in a window on the HDMI desktop. Logins are never saved unless you choose to.
